title: Mixed Event — Hello to a New Day!

meta.Outline: It's the start of a new school year and everyone has gone up a grade! That fact hasn't quite hit Ichika yet, but when Miku asks to see the opening ceremony, it spurs her to treat it like a special day.

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Let's see...
I've got my pencil case and folders...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That should be everything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Ichika!
You're going to be late for the opening ceremony if you keep dallying.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh...
Don't worry! I'll be out the door soon!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Starting today, I'm a second-year...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I don't really feel like one.)
<Good morning, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku!
What are you doing here at this time of day?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wanted to see how you were doing. You're a second-year starting today, right?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I became a little curious.
I was hoping to see what your new class and opening ceremony are going to be like.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What they're like...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean... Neither is going to feel all that special. I'm not sure if there'll be anything worth seeing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Really? I consider it a big day since it marks the beginning of so many new things.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
New things...
Yeah, I guess you're right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Ichika!
I'm serious! You're going to be late!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's my cue to head out...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'll keep my phone in my pocket.
You should be fine as long as you stay hidden while you watch like usual.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get going.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay!>
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy
Outside the Front Entrance

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Wow.
There's a ton of people gathered over there.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm guessing they've posted the new class rosters by the front entrance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see. That explains the buzz in the air.>
Hey, Ichi!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Morning, Ichi!
Hey, about the new class rosters...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Good morning, Saki.
You're as peppy as ever this morning.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! Miku?!
What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wanted to see what you girls are like now that you're second-years, as well as the opening ceremony.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <While staying hidden from view, of course.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?!
That means you also get to share in this fun and exciting moment!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Fun and exciting?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're gonna take a look at the new rosters now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's so fun and exciting because we get to find out who we're going to be with this upcoming year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see. Now I understand.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Saki, you haven't seen them yet...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nope!
I wanted to see them as a group!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: ...which is how we ended up waiting here for what felt like forever.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Miku, good morning.
I didn't realize you'd be joining us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Shiho! Honami!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Were you all waiting for me to get here? Sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was also hoping that we'd get to look at them together. It is always more fun that way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That was my point exactly!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't have a problem with looking at them alone, but Saki insisted.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
Shiho, that's so cold!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, relax.
We're all here now, so let's go take a look before the bell rings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So many people...>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think we're close enough to see them now. Let's see... We're...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, there!
I'm in Class A.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm there too...!
That means...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ichika!
We're in the same class!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?! You are?!
What about me...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nooo! I'm not in Class A!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki, look over there.
You're in Class B.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?
Hey, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm not with Ichi and Hona...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you're not with them. Instead...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait!
Shiho, Saki, you're in the same class!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Check it out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're right!!!!
Thank goodness, Shiho!!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Okay, try to calm down...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Everyone!
If you've already found your names, please start making your way towards your classes to prevent unnecessary crowding!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I was just feeling glad that I came over.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You said it wouldn't feel all that special, Ichika, but I'm having a lot of fun.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I got to see that look of anticipation on your faces, the joy you felt when you found out you'd be in the same classes, all sorts of things.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Seeing you girls... It feels like...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Like something new is really about to start today.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something new...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ichika?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had it in my mind that we'd just be shuffling classes and going to a new classroom...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But “just” might not be appropriate.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Today's a day that marks the beginning of a lot of new things.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm going to start treating this day like it's special and really try to cherish it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Try to have as much fun as you can today, Ichika!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
Ichi!
We're gonna be late!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Sorry, be right there!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, Miku, I hope you'll take a good look at what happens at our school and see how we all do today.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: 3rd_anv_movie
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That's it for this homeroom.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Next, we have the opening ceremony.
Please make sure to be there on time.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
That was quick.
We have a little time before the ceremony begins.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Then, let's go see what the other classes are up to! I wanna introduce you to some of my other friends!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
New classrooms always make me feel a little anxious...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I kind of know what you mean.
The view outside looks completely different.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, come to think of it...
Aside from us, our class also includes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ichika! Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane...!
Does this mean we're in the same class this year?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, and I couldn't be happier.
I'm really looking forward to this upcoming year.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think we are as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait, Kohane...
Have you been a bit short on sleep lately?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our team has been practicing a lot recently. We stayed out pretty late last night too. That might be why...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your team's practices have always seemed really tough, but does this mean you're practicing even harder now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We are. The practice regimens An's dad put together for us are so tough, but we've been managing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That sounds really difficult...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It is, and I feel exhausted at the end of each day.
But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel motivated to keep trying no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What we're after...
We know surpassing it won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I don't care how hard the road up ahead is. I'm going to do my absolute best and leave no regrets.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's really cool, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
How do I put it...?
You've always been hardworking, but you sound really strong now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree.
Your resolve to keep persevering sounded ironclad.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really...?
Hehe. Now I feel a little embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, Kohane, good luck.
We'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget to ask...
Which classes are Shiho and Saki in?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They're both in Class B.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know. We have a little time on our hands before the opening ceremony starts, so why don't we go see them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Good call.
Everyone else seems to be doing the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
The teacher actually just asked me to help with something. I need to head over to the office soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Well, we can always go see them some other time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, let's!
Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see. Saki and Shiho should be...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So! Here's to us being placed in the same class!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's make our second year also really wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm suuuper duper happy about us becoming classmates!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're gonna have so much fun together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Oh, I know! We should make Print Stickers together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great idea! It's always so much fun to doodle on them and stuff♪ Oh, and I wanna play some games together after!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I like it!
We could even follow up with a karaoke place, then have parfaits and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, all in one day?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Besides, we work and have band practice. We don't have much time to be playing around.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Oh, right...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu, that reminds me...
You guys are gonna start visiting a bunch of different venues and troupes, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
We had a long discussion about it, and decided we're gonna go to as many places as we can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're uhh...! Training together to make our dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Training...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, so I might not have as much time to hang out moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we're in the same class now, so I wanna spend at least a little time together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Just a little bit!
Pleeease, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine, just a little...

rows.Speaker: Emu & Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo!!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's kind of funny how powerless Shiho is when it comes to those two.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you here to see us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
Come on in!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know that you were also in Class B, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
I'm a little sad we're not together again...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But let's keep hanging out like we always have!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. We can even draw with Ena or spend more time with Mizuki and Ms. Yoisaki.

Oh!
Hi, everyone!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, that voice...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Morning, everyone.
You all seem to be enjoying yourselves this morning.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Haruka! Minori!
Good wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do neither of you have work today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We have today and tomorrow off.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, which classes are you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, thank you for asking!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, Minori Hanasato, have finally fulfilled my dream of...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Being in the same class as Haruka!
It's finally happened!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, that shouldn't come as much of a surprise since the credit-based course doesn't have that many people in it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, but...!
You don't get it, Shiho!
Being in the same class as Haruka means...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Being in the same classroom, breathing the same air and seeing what she's like during classes...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... I get to live the dream as a student! This is nothing short of a miracle! And I'm putting that lightly...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, now I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You must be feeling so wonderhoy, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's the Minori we're used to hearing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I am glad that we didn't get separated, Minori. This should definitely make things easier whenever we have to miss class and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: More importantly, I'm happy that you'll be there with me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Haruka...!
No, your aura's blinding...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is turning into some sort of weird new skit...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Sorry, I didn't mean to get carried away. I'm just so happy...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I'm okay now!
I'm going to do my absolute best as Minori Hanasato the idol moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, Minori Hanasato, am now a second-year in the credit-based course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going to work lots and lots for MORE MORE JUMP! I know that things might be tougher than before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm gonna keep doing what I can to spread hope to others!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can do it, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Everyone!
Let's start heading over to the gym!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, the opening ceremony's about to start.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no, I wanted to go early since the entrance to the gym's gonna be super crowded right before the start time...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, we got really engrossed in our conversation. Let's start heading over, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's head back to our classroom for a second. Kohane should be back by now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
See you all later!
Outside the Gym

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, you're both in the same class again, Hinomori, Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we are!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, we had a pretty good feeling that we would be. We just can't get rid of each other no matter how hard we try.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're in Class B, right, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Me? Yes.
But how did you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Because your name's always towards the top. It's hard not to see it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I see. That makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Still...
We're all in our final year now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It feels kinda weird to think we'll all have graduated in one year's time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But we can't be getting lost in thought.
Minori and Haruka showed us their commitment by going credit-based, so we gotta keep doing our best and show them how it's done.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
We need to do what we can as their seniors in the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You sound very motivated.
I'll need to do what I can to keep up with you two.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, while we're on the subject...
Would you mind telling us about your goals?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? My goals?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to spend so much time thinking.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A lot happened recently and...
I haven't had a chance to plan for the future.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you're ever in need of help, please feel free to let us know...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't know how much I can do for you, but shooting at the archery range together should help clear your mind...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We could even go out for some Japanese sweets like we did in Kyoto!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you...
Shizuku, Airi, Asahina! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, good morning!
It's rare to see you all together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you all in the same class?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes.
We're all in Class A.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Class A...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Please try to be careful with the door to the broom closet. It doesn't fit in the frame right and someone got hurt last year trying to open it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That happened...?!
Thank you very much for letting us know, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get why you're being so formal with her, but don't forget the new kids are gonna be looking up to you guys too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll all become wonderful role models.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At the same time, please feel free to ask us if you ever find yourselves in trouble. I'd like to do my best as well, as your senior.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I feel a lot better knowing that you'll be there for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the opening ceremony's going to start soon. We should get in line.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's go!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sounds like you're in a good mood, Saki.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I am!
I mean, today was just so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was a little anxious about what my new class was gonna look like, but it ended up feeling like a nice, fresh start!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree.
It was also nice to see some familiar faces.

Excellent!
Then, that's mission accomplished!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought I heard a familiar voice just now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Saki, everyone!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Miku, hide!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hiding.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are the odds that we'd run into each other here?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
N-Not very high!
What brings you here today, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I was just buying some running shoes.
The pair I was wearing reached its limit during practice the other day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you mentioned that earlier this morning! Did you find a pair you like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, and they're a perfect fit!
I was just heading home in the highest of spirits!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which explains why you said, “Mission accomplished,” just now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is “mission” really the right word for that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, how were things at Miya Girls? The opening ceremony was today, yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It was super fun!
Also, guess what? Shiho and I are in the same class♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that's wonderful to hear!
I hope you won't mind keeping an eye on her for me, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh, sure...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The opening ceremony for my school was also today. It ended up being quite the spectacle.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
What was it like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, where do I begin...?
First, when I headed over to my new class...
Kamiyama High School - Class 3-C

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-How...?! Can it be...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm in the same class as you, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, this is quite the surprise.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd heard rumors about naughty children being placed in separate classes in order to make things easier for the teachers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... Wait, naughty children?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In all likelihood, they decided it'd be easier to keep an eye on us if we were in the same class since we're seen together quite a lot.)

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Geez, they put the Weirdo Wombo Combo in the same class...?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
How is this okay...?
I don't even wanna think about what's gonna happen during class...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
This could be interesting.
They do always seem to have fun together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
We seem to be attracting quite a bit of attention.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do my classmates know a star when they see one?! Are they that entranced by my aura?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... That could be one reason...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, I'm glad that we're classmates. Let's do our best this year leading up to our graduation, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now, as for the opening ceremony...
I was about to head over, but we seem to still have some time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, of course!
Why don't we go over to see Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Nene?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes.
She didn't sound very excited about her new class during practice the other day. I was thinking that we could help her relax if she's still feeling nervous.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I'm not sure us visiting her class is going to make her feel any better...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But it may be worth taking a look.
I am interested in seeing what her class is like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's what I like to hear!
Let's head over to the second-year classrooms!
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Hey, wanna go to a karaoke place?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
We should also try inviting that other group!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
Everyone in this class...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They basically all seem like... Extroverts...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(How do I fit in here...?
What happens if I never really do...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I did see some familiar names on the roster, but...)
Hey!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Morning, Kusanagi!
So you're also in Class A! Let's have a great year together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: M-Morning, Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Never would've guessed they'd put me in the same class as you guys.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: M-Morning...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito!
You're in this class too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Wait, didn't you look at the class roster?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The roster? Nope.
A friend told me which class I'm in, so I didn't have to look. Plus, coming here was the fastest way to see my new classmates.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: True. You've got nerves of steel when it comes to this kind of stuff...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What's that supposed to mean?
Just so you know, I still care whether or not my friends are in the same class as me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm glad, though!
It looks like I've talked to basically everyone here at least once before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Basically everyone? How many friends do you have...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, aren't a bunch of your friends here too? I see all the soccer guys gathered over there.

rows.Speaker: Soccer Club Classmates
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito!
You should come join us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, in a sec.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (These two... They're so different from me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right! Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yeah?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Tenma told me everything!
You and your troupe are gonna leave the Wonder Stage to train and become better actors, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, that means we're training buddies!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Training buddies?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm also training to become a better singer. My dad's been taking us to all sorts of different places as a part of that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Really...?
You guys must be working pretty hard if you're traveling that much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We are!
That's why I said we're training buddies, since we're both doing what we can to improve!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Buddies...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, um... Let's do our best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!
Pardon the intrusioooooon!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh oh...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
What are they doing where all the second-years are...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that the Weirdo Wombo Combo?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: What are they doing in our class?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: J-Just pretend like you don't know them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heeeey! Neneeee!
How are you liking your new class?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you getting along with your new classmates?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, what are you...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Nene... Who's that?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Oh, they mean Kusanagi.
She's over there. She does shows with them.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Really? I never would've guessed. She doesn't seem the type.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh geez...!

I knew it!
See, it was Tsukasa's voice we heard just now!
Looks like we weren't mistaken.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-Now who's coming...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, that looks like...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Mizuki. Ah, with Aoyagi in tow.
Can I assume that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! We're both right next door in Class B!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama and I were talking just now and suddenly heard a booming voice from this direction...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We thought it might be Tsukasa, so we decided to see what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, and here you both are.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, Toya, I'm so glad they put us in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The teacher asked me to carry a bunch of stuff, but you immediately came to the rescue after I complained how heavy it was♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When faced with a classmate in need, isn't it normal to want to help out?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Indeed!
That was very noble of you, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, try not to be so easily fooled in the future...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Mizuki does have a talent for that.
I recommend keeping your cards a little closer to your chest.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama's always been very kind to me... I hadn't realized. I'll be more careful.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Rui, don't pile on!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Talk about a rough road up ahead...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I think they're gonna get along just fine!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed!
If nothing else, I'm happy to see that everyone is all smiles!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone, let's make this year another good one!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, everyone seemed to be very excited about their new situations!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm glad everyone at Kamiyama High's also enjoying things.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya and Mizuki being in the same class sounds like so much fun! I wish I could be their classmate!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But Shiho would be so sad if you left your current class.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you're right...!
Then, I'll stay where I am♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Great, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seeing everybody having fun and enjoying themselves really is a sight to behold.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A thought crossed my mind today.
About how wonderful it is to see so many people smiling and laughing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright!
Once I get home, I'll put on my new shoes and go for a run!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to keep building up my stamina if I'm going to make more people smile!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, look at the time. I think we can use that studio now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We should start heading over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, you have practice today.
I'm sorry I kept you for so long.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well then, do your best!
Farewell!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Bye bye!
See you at home!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It was nice to hear such a fun story, wasn't it?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was.
He definitely seemed to be enjoying things as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we need to hurry over to the studio if we're gonna make our reservation.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...!
We should run if we don't want to lose any time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!
A few hours later
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Nice work!
For some reason, I felt really good during today's practice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I also seemed to play better than usual on the drums.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, you all played with great energy.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, we did?
Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Miku's right. We got off to a really good start today. Let's do our best to keep this up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, see you all tomorrow.
Nice work today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thank you for today, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm really grateful about you letting me tag along to spectate. I'm so glad I did...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
You were right. This day ended up being more special than I initially expected.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, it's from my mom...
“Could you grab some soy sauce at the store on your way home?”...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The supermarket's a bit out of the way, but okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Looks like your special day's getting a slight extension.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure running an errand counts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Really?
I think it's a meaningful mission.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A mission...? I'm not Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What's wrong, Ichika?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Over there. That looks like...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade! Ena!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hoshino.
I never would've guessed we'd run into each other here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me neither.
Can I ask what you two are doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was just on my way to school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, now?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I take night classes.
We have our opening ceremony in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At night? I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My opening ceremony was also today, but that happened earlier.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Kanade, I thought you were enrolled in a correspondence school. They hold opening ceremonies?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Other schools might handle these things differently, but mine holds them like normal. They ask that we be in attendance whenever we can...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena contacted me after it ended and we were talking at a diner until just a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How were things at school today, Ichika?
Everyone's in new classes and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, yes.
Honami and I are in the same class now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're with Ms. Mochizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's great to hear that you're both in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I was really glad to know we'll be together.
We have two others in our band who were both placed in another class, which also made them happy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And during practice just now, we got really into it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
This kind of fresh new beginning really gives you a boost, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. It does.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
Umm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I can't say this for sure...
But after talking with everyone today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I was emboldened by their motivation.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What we're after...
We know surpassing it won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I don't care how hard the road up ahead is. I'm going to do my absolute best and leave no regrets.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going to work lots and lots for MORE MORE JUMP! I know that things might be tougher than before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm gonna keep doing what I can to spread hope to others!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright!
Once I get home, I'll put on my new shoes and go for a run!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to keep building up my stamina if I'm going to make more people smile!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're all looking forward to making their dreams come true by overcoming any obstacles that come their way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Seeing that made me want to do the same and try just as hard.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to give you my diary of things...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
I think I understand what you're saying.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hearing your story is making me want to try harder as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You too?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: During the opening ceremony today, I started thinking more about the future...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is more of a personal matter, but a lot of things have been happening recently that required careful attention.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we were talking about that at the diner just now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't say that I've been able to set goals for myself and do what I can to accomplish them like you and the others, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But your story did make me want to try harder moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I didn't say much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, if what happened to me today is giving you a little extra push... Then I'm glad I told you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I should get going.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't mean to keep you so long...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
See you, Ichika! And we'll talk again later tonight, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, good luck at school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I should start heading home as well...
See you later, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay! See you!
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So much happened today.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm in a new class, got to talk to my seniors, had band practice, ran into Kanade and Ena...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't say that I've been able to set goals for myself and do what I can to accomplish them like you and the others, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But your story did make me want to try harder moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What made Kanade feel that way...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ichika?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry, I was just spacing out.
I was thinking about everything that happened today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, you had quite an eventful day.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<And I had a lot of fun as a result.
I got to learn so much about the new term at your school, and see all your friends.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Also...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I got to see that Kanade person feel encouraged by your words.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Remember what she said?
She felt like trying harder after hearing your story.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You did what the others did for you, Ichika. You became a source of encouragement for Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I feel that all of that may be connected little by little.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Seeing others try their hardest causes people to feel a variety of things. You may want to give them your support, you may want to do better yourself or match their efforts...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <One person giving it their best causes others to want to do the same.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Isn't that wonderful?
Your efforts may be encouraging and motivating them without you knowing it.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm encouraging them...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I sure hope so.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But if that's true, then I want my music to give others the push they need.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My words and attitude helping others is one thing, but I also want to do that with my music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Right.
And I'm sure you'll be able to, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I'm going to practice on my own until dinner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, then... Why don't you come over to SEKAI? I'd like to play with you.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
Then, if you don't mind having me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Okay.
Then, I'll start getting ready over there.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...!
I forgot to say something really important.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hm?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku.
Thank you for joining me today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I'm looking forward to working with you more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to that as well, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I thought I was just going to start being a second-year in my new class today.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But Miku made me realize it was much more than that.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I started to see it as a special day and decided to be conscious of how everything made me feel...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Now I feel like I'm ready to take another big step.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm going to keep doing my best in my second year...!
